sloka: ततः प्रयाते जनके केकयं मातुलं प्रभुः ।राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.३८.९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prayāte janake kekayaṁ mātulaṁ prabhuḥ ।rāghavaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.38.9 ॥

translations.english: After Janaka had departed, Lord Rama, with folded hands, then spoke these words to his maternal uncle, Kekaya.
